dct_description_sm: Impacts of Seismic Trails, Camp Trails and Ice Roads on Tundra Vegetation in the Northeast NPR-A. Monitor stream gauging station likely to be crossed by future oil and gas development in the next 10-15 years. The results demonstrate how vegetation type and trail type influence the level of impacts, and how recovery progresses over time. The study will compare impacts to the tundra and tundra vegetation recovery to sites elsewhere on the North Slope. Soils (active layer) and vegetation measurements.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Environment surveillance
dct_title_s: National Petroleum Reserve Alaska (NPR-A) Gauging Stations
